stage: Real-anchor identifiability audit; no proxy metrics
main_fit: Use the frozen stage1 soft-L1 fit and full multi-start grid on each anchor0..7/cell. Reuse completed identical stage2 main anchor0/1 fits; no refitting finished stages.
strict_validity: Reject fitted/profile states with any theta outside [0,1] anywhere from q=0 through observed charge end. Re-solve pack endpoints only inside valid model domains; no interpolation clipping may create accepted target outputs.

LLI_profiles.fixed: QLi = QLi_reference_point - LLI; reference is stage2 main anchor0
LLI_profiles.grid: QLi50..250 step10, include fitted center and center plus/minus .25,.5,1,2,4,8,16,32,64, clipped to bounds
LLI_profiles.refit: All other five parameters refit using frozen soft-L1 least squares; starts include the optimum and neighboring profile fits. Compare against true unconstrained optimum; cache every parameter/data/OCP/source hash.

confidence.n_eff: n/(1+2 sum positive rho_lag) using full residual FFT autocovariance, first nonpositive lag termination; floor1, capn
confidence.sigma_mV: max(2 mV, residual RMS), reflecting model mismatch
confidence.cell95: chi2 df1 .95 threshold; report bounded-grid truncation
confidence.pack95: Bonferroni alpha=.05/4 per-cell profile envelopes, then re-solve pack quantities over Cartesian profile combinations. Exact enumeration when <=65536 combinations; otherwise deterministic witnessed combinations and label target ranges lower bounds, never certify a narrow gate from sampling.

pack_quantities: Registered ideal 20.4A/14V/5.1A CCCV conventions, but reject sum(R)<=0 rather than the undocumented1e-6 floor. Enforce every cell stoichiometric domain. Program current10.782A and original midpoint windows; all4 cells must yield a step. C20 uses fixed stage2 main eta_dis and measured c_pack=-.003, first11.2V root; no extrapolation.
envelope_design: Include each cell optimum, all one-cell profile excursions, common-index excursions, extrema in health parameters, and fixed-seed randomized Cartesian tuples if exhaustive enumeration exceeds cap. Unavailable roots or unsupported/truncated ranges fail eligibility; finite witnessed width already exceeding a gate can prove rejection.
beta_range: Simulate pack reference anchor1 and current profiles from a common reference start-OCV vector; compute joint numerator/denominator envelopes. Denominator range containing zero means beta range unbounded/unavailable.
LLI_monotonicity: Report both fitted-point monotonicity and feasibility of a nondecreasing sequence within the nominal mean per-cell profile intervals; a boundary-truncated interval cannot certify identification.
exit_rule: Proceed stage4 only if stage1d passes AND >=5/7 finite certified Q_C20 intervals width<=.6Ah AND >=5/7 finite certified beta intervals width<=.3 AND LLI monotone within95 intervals. Otherwise stage4 diagnostic-only with no model proxy evaluation.
variants: No alternate main fits selected by proxy. Stage4 variants only if the exit rule passes.
exposure: exposed-exploratory; no hidden capacity labels; nominal profile intervals are conditional diagnostic ranges, not externally calibrated coverage.
